targets.old_statement: Drivers behind or beside a stopped school bus with flashing red lights must stop, and only drivers going the opposite way on a divided highway are excused, so an undivided road means traffic in both directions stops.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Drivers behind or beside a stopped school bus with flashing red lights must stop, and only drivers going the opposite way on a divided highway are excused, so an undivided road means traffic in both directions stops.
targets.statement: Upon seeing a stopped school bus with flashing red lights, you must stop at least twenty feet away unless you are traveling in the opposite direction on a divided highway.
